summary: The patched package (solve.sh applying fix.patch) implements every SOP TM-07 rule (fitted-intercept OLS, blank mean of results only, (reading-level)*dilution, flags on corrected reading with exclusive loq, rounded inclusive CCV pass, two-sided bracketing, SOP 7 spike recovery when both are results) and keeps the shipped calculation exactly where the SOP gives no rule; no concrete incorrect behavior found.
checks_performed: Reconciled all 22 manifest files with files read; all read in full, none truncated.

Verified every fix.patch hunk header and context line against the shipped sources (blanks.py 1-8, calib.py 9-17, qc.py 6-21, report.py 15-21/30-35/38-43/60-65, samples.py 6-18) so `patch -p1` from / applies cleanly; Dockerfile installs patch.
Traced SOP 2: patched fit_line uses centered sxy/sxx with intercept mean_y - slope*mean_x; sxx>0 guaranteed by SOP 1 (two distinct concentrations).
Traced SOP 3: reading = (response - intercept)/slope unchanged and unclamped; negative readings flow through.

Traced SOP 4: blank_level averages blank readings >= mdl across all blanks regardless of position; with no blank result falls back to shipped first-blank reading or 0.0 (SOP silent per SOP 3 last sentence and instruction line 5).
Traced SOP 5: amount = (reading - level)*dilution; flag uses corrected reading: < mdl ND, < loq J, else ''; mdl==loq at corrected==mdl gives ''; value null only for ND.

Traced SOP 6: recovery unrounded in report; pass = 90.0 <= round(recovery,1) <= 110.0; SOP 1 excludes rounding ties within 1e-6 so Python round-half-even cannot differ; true >= 10*loq > 0 so no division by zero.

Traced SOP 6 bracketing: nearest CCV before and after both required to pass when both exist; otherwise shipped rule (nearest before, else True) retained for runs before first CCV, after last CCV, and CCV-free batches.

Traced SOP 7: detected = corrected >= mdl for spike and parent (SOP 3: sample/spike judged on corrected reading); both results -> (spike amount - parent amount)/added*100; otherwise shipped (added*dilution) denominator over SOP amounts; recovery always numeric.
Traced SOP 8 report: samples/ccvs/spikes lists in run order then batch analyte order; blank_levels keyed by name; numbers unrounded; driver untouched.

Walked small-batch.json path (CCV-1, MB-1, sample, spike, sample, CCV-2) through patched report.py to confirm no KeyError on parent lookup (detected/amounts populated for all sample runs before spike loop).

rules: SOP 4 blank level from blank results
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: Several blanks with some below mdl; level = mean of those >= mdl; sample flag judged on reading - level, amount then multiplied by dilution (flag independent of dilution).
Spike or parent corrected reading below mdl -> both_results False -> shipped denominator; exactly on mdl -> result -> SOP 7 formula.
Sample between passing CCV and CCV at 110.04 (rounds to 110.0, passes) -> ccv_ok true; between passing and failing CCV -> false; sample after last CCV -> nearest-before rule.
All blanks below mdl (or no blank) -> level = first blank reading (possibly negative) or 0.0, then amount = (reading - level)*dilution per SOP 5.
